verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for llms.txt at developers.clerky.com, and it lists agent-friendly markdown (index.md) pages for the Partner API docs. Those pages, including Introduction, Lifecycle, Authentication and the MCP Server setup guide, are served as clean markdown an agent can ingest directly. The 404s on handbooks.clerky.com show the handbook/legal-concepts content has no llms.txt or markdown mirror, but they do not contradict the developer site. Missing for 10: llms.txt/markdown coverage of the handbooks (legal-concepts) content, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming the docs.
